title: Authenticated owner-authorized track HTTP API
purpose: Expose the existing owner-authorized track operation service through authenticated private HTTP routes without adding browser persistence authority, R2 authority, public track authority, or Studio UI.

authorization.source: Authenticated Principal session resolved through explicit PrincipalId to SeshCreatorId mapping.
authorization.ownerAuthority: SeshProjectOwnershipAuthorizer inside the canonical track operation service.

boundaries: No Studio track UI is added.
No direct browser D1 access is added.
No R2 or audio-byte authority is added.
No SESH_AUDIO runtime dependency is added.
No audio asset attachment or detachment API is added.
No public track API is added.
No copyright, publishing, master, management, licensing, or royalty semantics are added.
